text: Noting your discontent, the bridge crew tries their best to assess the situation swiftly and silently.

"We have no explanation, sir. " The officer looks down in shame. "The drive field was properly synced and the link established between the gates. We're still awaiting a report on the Janus device's condition."

The officer nods before tapping at his tripad, sending you pictures taken by cameras on the hull. "The fleet's combined coverage could barely confirm there even was something until they were on top of us. We had to get a visual to even hazard a guess." You look at the images taken, barely making out shapes against the darkness of space. "Ships. Though nothing we recognise."

"Sir!" Your comms officer calls over, pale as a ghost yet maintaining proper etiquette. "I believe you may want to see this for yourself." He says while leading you over to his post, a communication request flashing on the screen. Without a word the officer displays the attached fleet information and a wave of surprise washes over you.

In front of your eyes is the unmistakable and near ubiquitous emblem you have come to associate with all things past, the Domain of Man's.

text: "I can assure you it is quite alive and thriving, captain." The voice corrects on the other end. "I understand you may perceive so, we have held a no contact policy for both your sector's sake and the Domain at large. You deserve answers, and answers you shall have."

"And you have been vindicated." The voice says approvingly. "I am aware we have a lot of explaining to do, and are opened to answer any questions you may have once our business is concluded." He pauses "Within reasonable boundaries of course."

"Considering you have proven yourself uniquely capable, the Ministry wishes to enlist your help to assist our mission." He pauses for a moment before continuing. "Given that the potential reopening of the gates (highlight that) is closely tied to success of said mission, it is within your and the sector's interest to cooperate.  "I am sure you had good intentions at heart, but unknowingly almost shattered two centuries of work." He pauses. "Without mentioning putting in danger the lives of trillions." Another pause "But these faults can be forgiven, among many other benefits."
